teams.synopsis: Undefeated through 7 weeks, projected for a league-high 11 wins — but expect a slowdown facing a hungry field.
teams.blurb: Undefeated through 7 weeks, but will that continue as they face a hungry opponent? I like the idea of the franchise winning its first ring in 2025, but as for the rest of the regular season, I have them slowing down quite a bit. Still, they're projected a league-high 11 wins. Second-half strength of schedule rank: 8th. Current record: 7-0. Projected: 11-3.

teams.synopsis: The hottest thing out there right now — 188 points in Week 7 against another top team says it all.
teams.blurb: STD is the hottest thing out there right now. A 188-point performance in Week 7 against another top team is exactly what you want out of a contender. The record isn't the greatest, sitting at 4-3 currently, but I expect that to get much better as we commence the 2nd half of 2025. Second-half strength of schedule rank: 11th. Current record: 4-3. Projected: 10-4.

teams.synopsis: The stars are aligning for a 6-1 finish down the stretch — the easiest schedule in the league, no excuses left.
teams.blurb: The stars are aligning for The Minutemen to go on a great run to finish the 2025 season, as I project them to go 6-1 the rest of the way. With the team coming together and the easiest schedule in the league, there's no excuse for the team not to finish as a top seed and make a championship run. Second-half strength of schedule rank: 1st. Current record: 3-4. Projected: 9-5.

teams.synopsis: Who saw a 6-1 start coming? A fun return to the top after a few down years and a short retirement.
teams.blurb: Who would have thought this team would be 6-1 this season? Definitely not me, but it's fun to see this franchise back towards the top after a few down years and a short retirement. Now, I do expect a step back in the 2nd half of the season, but making the playoffs is all that matters. Second-half strength of schedule rank: 12th. Current record: 6-1. Projected: 9-5.

teams.synopsis: A sneaky dark horse for a title run — Jonathan Taylor's been the fantasy MVP of the season so far.
teams.blurb: A sneaky team and a dark horse to make a championship run in 2025. Jonathan Taylor has been the fantasy MVP this season, and if Terry and Wilson can get healthy, then this team will be right there with the top-tier teams. An easier schedule to finish the season is also helpful. Second-half strength of schedule rank: 4th. Current record: 5-2. Projected: 9-5.

teams.synopsis: Things might get ugly with the toughest remaining schedule in the league — still one of the best teams when healthy.
teams.blurb: Things might get ugly for Grits, especially with the toughest schedule to finish the season. Still, I think this team is one of the best when healthy, but they'll have to actually be healthy to have a chance. I expect another loss this week, but I wouldn't be worried if I were them. Second-half strength of schedule rank: 14th. Current record: 5-2. Projected: 9-5.

teams.synopsis: Continuously climbing the rankings every week — another great Week 8 could finally crack the top 6.
teams.blurb: Do I give them their flowers now? I think so. NY has continuously climbed the rankings every week, and that trend ain't stopping just yet. It'll be hard to crack that top 6, but another great performance in Week 8, and I may have no choice. Prove me wrong. Second-half strength of schedule rank: 3rd. Current record: 4-3. Projected: 7-7.

teams.synopsis: Adopting the underdog mindset — a Week 8 win over MFGA could cement this team as a legit threat.
teams.blurb: Is this the PFFL's 2025 underdog? I think the team is adopting that mindset, but it's yet to be seen if they can truly be the underdogs. However, they get MFGA in Week 8, and a win there could solidify their status as a legit opponent. The schedule appears tough, but I didn't hear no bell. Second-half strength of schedule rank: 13th. Current record: 3-4. Projected: 7-7.

teams.synopsis: A good team on paper that always struggles by November — needs a Week 8 win to be taken seriously.
teams.blurb: It can't go on like this, can it? It can... and it has. RWB is a weird franchise because they always seem to have a good team on paper, but then we get to November and they're fighting for a playoff spot. They'll have to win in Week 8 against a weak team if they want to be taken seriously. Second-half strength of schedule rank: 6th. Current record: 2-5. Projected: 6-8.

teams.synopsis: 3-4 isn't the worst record, but bottom-five in points scored isn't great — 10th seems the likeliest outcome.
teams.blurb: Hello there, you. I don't really know what to do with this team. 3-4 is not the worst record to have, but to be bottom five in total points scored is not great. I think with some luck, there is a future where the team makes a playoff push, but 10th seems like the most likely outcome. Second-half strength of schedule rank: 10th. Current record: 3-4. Projected: 5-9.

teams.synopsis: 11th might be a weird sight for a 1-6 team, but one of the easiest second-half schedules gives real hope.
teams.blurb: 11th might be a weird sight for a 1-6 team, but I think there's hope. RBT has one of the easiest 2nd-half schedules, and the return of Rice brings life to this team, which was evident in Week 7. Having six losses already almost eliminates you from the playoffs, but I've seen crazier things. Second-half strength of schedule rank: 2nd. Current record: 1-6. Projected: 5-9.

teams.synopsis: A 4th straight loss with no relief in the Week 8 projection — floating in no-man's-land, no punishment, no playoffs.
teams.blurb: Oh boy. I start off 3-0 and feel alright about my team, but now Week 7 marked the 4th loss in a row for the franchise, and things don't look any brighter in Week 8's projection. The team will be decent enough to float in no-man's-land — no punishment, no playoffs. Second-half strength of schedule rank: 5th. Current record: 3-4. Projected: 5-9.

teams.synopsis: The fewest points in the entire league despite two wins — playoff hopes appear dead, but punishment should be avoidable.
teams.blurb: Despite having two wins, Burn has the fewest points scored across the entire league, with the next-worst team having 20 more points. Still, I think the team will be strong enough to avoid punishment in 2025, but playoff aspirations appear to be dead. Second-half strength of schedule rank: 9th. Current record: 2-5. Projected: 4-10.

teams.synopsis: Not much left to say — the struggles look set to continue, with one more win the realistic ceiling.
teams.blurb: There's not much to say about TTF that hasn't been said already. The team has had a difficult time in 2025, and that doesn't look like it will stop anytime soon. I have the team picking up one more win this season, but I wouldn't be shocked if the team finishes with only one win. Second-half strength of schedule rank: 7th. Current record: 1-6. Projected: 2-12.
